source.author: ov
source.text: Videt igne micantes sideribus similes oculos, videt oscula, quae non est vidisse satis; laudat digitosque manusque bracchiaque et nudos media plus parte lacertos.
source.text_original: Videt igne micantes / sideribus similes oculos, videt oscula, quae non / est vidisse satis; laudat digitosque manusque / bracchiaque et nudos media plus parte lacertos.
source.text_english: He sees eyes sparkling like stars, he sees kisses, which it is not enough merely to have seen; he praises her fingers and hands and arms and, bare though they are above all in their middle part, her limbs.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hanc Panope Dotoque soror laetataque fluctu prosequitur nitidis pariter Galatea lacertis alta petens: Siculo revocat de litore Cyclops.
reuse.text_original: hanc Panope Dotoque soror laetataque fluctu / prosequitur nitidis pariter Galatea lacertis / alta petens: Siculo revocat de litore Cyclops.
reuse.text_english: To this one Panope, and her sister Doto, rejoicing in the wave, and Galatea too, with gleaming arms, follows, seeking the deep: the Cyclops recalls her from the Sicilian shore.
